definitions.explanation: A state of being incomplete or not functioning fully. Most often appears in medical compounds naming the failure of an organ or bodily function.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心不全|しんふぜん}→心不全：28546_shinfuzen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather was hospitalized with heart failure.

examples.japanese: {腎不全|じんふぜん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{進行|しんこう}している→進行する：26794_shinkousuru⟧。
examples.english: His kidney failure is progressing little by little.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発育不全|はついくふぜん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The examination revealed a developmental insufficiency.

notes:
Prefix {不|ふ} (not) + ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (complete). Rarely used alone; it normally attaches to another noun naming what is failing or incomplete.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{心不全|しんふぜん}→心不全：28546_shinfuzen⟧: heart failure
- {腎不全|じんふぜん}: kidney failure
- {機能不全|きのうふぜん}: dysfunction, failure to function
- {発育不全|はついくふぜん}: stunted growth, developmental insufficiency
